title: Compose paid factor signings quadratically on a prescribed Cartesian product
statement: Given bipartite H with grading P, factor signed adjacencies S_H,S_K and paid constructors/explicit factor signings, P S_H=-S_H P. Set S_G=S_H tensor I+P tensor S_K on EXACT original Cartesian edges. It is an undirected +/-1 signing; cross terms cancel and S_G^2=S_H^2 tensor I+I tensor S_K^2, hence ||S_G||^2=||S_H||^2+||S_K||^2. For degrees a,b>=3 and sharp factor bounds, norm<=2sqrt(a+b-2)<2sqrt(a+b-1). Assembly is deterministic polynomial BIT in explicit product size GIVEN the factor signings; factor-constructor cost/randomness is inherited, not silently derandomized. Xu supplies the bipartite factor. A product that is ALSO unsigned Ramanujan gives a sharp promised-base lift; the tensor identity does not guarantee that unsigned promise or find a decomposition of every arbitrary input.
